sentences.text: Parabacteroides distasonis is an anaerobic bacterium and a commensal of the human gut.
It can convert primary bile acids into secondary bile acids and is studied as a potential probiotic.
In mouse experiments it showed anti-inflammatory properties, attenuating tumorigenesis and promoting intestinal barrier integrity in a colorectal cancer model.
Studies have reported depletion of this species in patients with psoriasis and reduced abundance in overweight individuals.
